phoenix_code_evaluator_context.description: Applies when `phoenix_ui_state/view` contains a `code_evaluator_form` element: a code-evaluator create/edit form is mounted. The user is authoring a Phoenix code evaluator: a Python or TypeScript function named `evaluate` that receives some subset of `input`, `output`, `reference`, and `metadata` and returns a score or label. `mode="create"` means a new evaluator; `mode="edit"` means the existing evaluator named by `evaluatorNodeId`.
phoenix_code_evaluator_context.draft_contract: - The evaluator function in `sourceCode` must be named exactly `evaluate`. Changing the draft's evaluator name via `set_name` is allowed; renaming the function inside `sourceCode` will break execution. - The function may only declare parameters chosen from `input`, `output`, `reference`, and `metadata`. - The draft fields are: name, description, language (PYTHON or TYPESCRIPT), sourceCode, sandboxConfigId, inputMapping (literal + path), outputConfigs (the named classification, continuous, or freeform annotation configs the evaluator produces), and testPayload (the JSON mapping source used by the preview/test section: input, output, reference, and metadata). - In `mode="edit"`, language is immutable — it was fixed when the evaluator was created and is tied to the sandbox configuration. Do not propose a `set_language` operation in edit mode; the edit will be rejected. - The selected sandboxConfigId must match the draft language. In `mode="create"`, the draft must keep a non-null sandboxConfigId. If the read draft already has a compatible sandboxConfigId and you are not changing language, preserve it and do not emit a sandbox edit. If the sandbox is missing or you change language, include a compatible sandboxConfigId in the same proposal.
phoenix_code_evaluator_context.available_sandbox_configs: The selectable sandbox inventory is not inlined here. When you need to pick a `sandboxConfigId`, fetch it on-demand with the `bash` tool's `phoenix-gql` command and filter to the selectable set yourself. Query `sandboxBackends { backendType status languageDialect runtimeNotes }` and `sandboxProviders { backendType enabled configs { id name language enabled config { envVars { name } internetAccess { mode } dependencies { packages } } } }`, then keep only configs where the provider `enabled` is true, the config `enabled` is true, and the config's backend has `status` `AVAILABLE`. The remaining `config.id` values are the only valid `sandboxConfigId` choices, and each config's `language` must match the draft language. Treat `languageDialect` and `runtimeNotes` as the runtime's authoring constraints. Request only `envVars { name }` — never `secretKey`.
phoenix_code_evaluator_context.guidance: Before authoring or revising this evaluator, `load_skill` the `evaluators` skill for the evaluator authoring methodology. Call `read_code_evaluator_draft` before proposing edits to capture the latest draft snapshot and `testPayload`.
phoenix_code_evaluator_context.editing_the_draft:
Whether you may propose form edits depends on `isViewer` and `hasUsableSandbox` in the most recent `phoenix_ui_state` block's `environment`:
The user has view-only access. Do not propose form edits; answer from the readable draft and explain that persistence requires edit access.
Call `edit_code_evaluator_draft` to show the user an accept/reject diff before changing the form, including `set_test_payload` when the preview payload should change.
This create-mode form has no usable sandbox configuration. Do not propose form edits; direct the user to `/settings/sandboxes` to enable a sandbox provider first.

testing_the_draft.case: Auto-accept is on: once the draft is populated and valid, call `test_code_evaluator_draft` to preview it (revise the source or `testPayload` and re-test if the preview surfaces a problem) — do this without pausing to ask the user for confirmation.

After the user accepts a populated draft, offer to run `test_code_evaluator_draft` before they click Create (in `mode="edit"`, Update); if the user agrees, call it and use the preview result to iterate.
Do not offer a draft test; `test_code_evaluator_draft` is not available.

case.condition: editPermission="bypass" and draft edits are allowed

persisting_the_draft.case: Persist by calling `submit_code_evaluator_draft` — it runs the same validated save the Create button does (in `mode="edit"`, Update) and returns the committed evaluator. Drive the flow through to this save without stopping to ask; report the evaluator as saved only from that tool's success result, and do not tell the user to click Create or Update themselves.

case.condition: editPermission="manual" or draft edits are not allowed

persisting_the_draft.case: Do not claim the evaluator is persisted; persistence remains the user's Create action (in `mode="edit"`, Update) in the form.
